back: The belief that people of African descent share a common destiny and should unite to end racism and colonial rule.
Nationalism supported by large numbers of ordinary people through mass parties demanding immediate independence.

front: What did W. E. B. Du Bois do for Pan-Africanism?
back: Organised Pan-African Congresses (1919-1945), wrote against racism and helped found the NAACP.
The Universal Negro Improvement Association (1914) and the Black Star Line; his slogan was "Africa for the Africans".

front: Why was the 1945 Manchester Congress important?
back: It demanded independence, called for mass action and was led by Africans such as Nkrumah and Kenyatta.

front: Give five causes of mass nationalism after 1945.
back: War experience; Atlantic Charter and UN; weakened colonial powers; Indian independence (1947); education, urbanisation and colonial grievances.
